*   **S1 (Template):** 1.5% pass rate [c1], [c5]

While S4 had the highest pass rate, a subsequent human-analyst inter-rater exercise revealed that the AI scoring instrument overestimated quality in a significant proportion of cases, with a 61.7% verdict-flip rate across 60 dual-scored reports [c2], [c5].
